fusions.name: Lily Flick
fusions.desc: A thrust at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full range. It slows the target by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Sprung Trap
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: springs on it for 8 damage and uses up every affliction on it, adding 1.8 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Marsh Draw
fusions.desc: Lays a line of sucking water 5 tiles long for 6 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Spring Clear
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, a ward absorbs damage equal to 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds. You gain +8% dodge chance.
